title: STABLE-CELL-SET: the 5-site re-draw-stable certified set as a partition on the clean free tree R1 af_clean_s42 — does it carry a key-built profile on the pool of record?

plain_description.what: Takes the 5 cells of the label-free clean tree that stay stable across re-draws, uses them as a 5-group partition of 3,445 questions, and checks with answer keys whether they support a reliable model profile, compared with the 14 named MMLU-Pro categories.
plain_description.why: Asks whether a label-free tree yields a usable home for per-cell model profiles.
plain_description.information: It shows whether label-free cells can replace named categories for profiling. Result: done; yes in a weak sense only: reliability 0.93, but a random 5-way grouping of the named categories reaches 0.91, the result leans on one uncertified catch-all cell, and the cells carry about half the information of the 14 names.
